assets.prompt: A precise pencil sketch illustration showing an elegant transparent inbox constructed from architectural wireframes and blueprint lines, hovering above a clean white surface. Below it, important letters and documents fall silently through invisible floor panels into darkness, their edges traced in delicate graphite. A few critical messages glow faintly with orange highlights as they slip through the gaps. The composition emphasizes structured emptiness—what appears organized above conceals loss below. Sophisticated editorial style, hand-drawn lines, minimal elements, large negative space, gunmetal charcoals with sparse orange accent, matte finish, contemporary office environment suggested through clean geometric forms.

altText.en: Abstract visualization of layered transparent screens with scattered data points, some highlighted in red while others fade into blue shadows
altText.es: Visualización abstracta de pantallas transparentes superpuestas con puntos de datos dispersos, algunos resaltados en rojo mientras otros se desvanecen en sombras azules
